title: Trade
body:
Syntax: trade <player>  |  trade add <item>  |  trade remove <item>  |  trade ryo <amount>  |  trade confirm  |  trade  |  trade cancel

Description: A full negotiated trade with another player -- items and ryo, staged and reviewed by both sides before anything actually moves. Both players must stay in the SAME ROOM for the entire negotiation; either side leaving cancels the trade outright, with nothing exchanged.

&Ctrade <player>&x - Proposes a trade to someone in the room, or accepts a pending proposal from them.
  &G[Active]&x

&Ctrade add <item>&x / &Ctrade remove <item>&x - Adds or removes an item from YOUR OWN offer. You can never touch the other side's offer, only see it.
  &G[Active]&x

&Ctrade ryo <amount>&x - Sets how much ryo you're offering, replacing any amount set before.
  &G[Active]&x

&Ctrade confirm&x - Locks in your current offer as final. The trade only completes once BOTH sides have confirmed.
  &G[Active]&x

&Ctrade&x (no arguments) - Shows both offers side by side and each side's confirmation status.
  &G[Active]&x

&Ctrade cancel&x - Backs out entirely, before or after accepting. Nothing is ever exchanged unless both sides confirm.
  &G[Active]&x

&D(Changing your offer in any way -- adding, removing, or changing the ryo amount -- resets BOTH sides' confirmations, even if the OTHER side already confirmed. A trade can never complete on terms that weren't both agreed to at the same moment.)&x

Date: 2026-08-25
